source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (general ledger account reconciliation); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.name: Extract GL and comparison balances
steps.description: GL balances and comparison balances (bank, subledger, third party) are extracted for every in-scope account due under its risk-rated frequency, with foreign-currency balances retranslated at the closing rate.
inputs: Reconciliation schedule by account risk rating

steps.name: Transaction matching
steps.description: Transactions are matched between the GL and the comparison source, automatically where rules allow and manually otherwise.

steps.name: Investigate and classify reconciling items
steps.description: Unmatched items are investigated, explained, supported with evidence and classified.

steps.name: Prepare adjusting journal entries
steps.description: Adjusting journal entries are prepared for items requiring correction, with prior-period errors corrected retrospectively.

steps.name: Preparer sign-off
steps.description: The preparer signs off the completed reconciliation.

steps.name: Reviewer approval
steps.description: An independent reviewer reviews and approves the reconciliation and its adjusting entries.

steps.name: Escalate aged reconciling items
steps.description: Reconciling items beyond the ageing threshold are escalated for resolution.

steps.name: Retain evidence and report status
steps.description: Reconciliation evidence is retained and reconciliation status is reported.

requirements.statement: Whatever carries balance extraction must still consume the reconciliation schedule by account risk rating.

required_inputs: Reconciliation schedule by account risk rating

requirements.statement: Transaction matching must survive in some form.
Investigation and classification of reconciling items must survive in some form.
Preparation of adjusting journal entries must survive in some form.
Journal entry preparation and reconciliation review must not be performed by the same actor.
Whatever carries preparation of adjusting journal entries must still consume the prior-period error record (KB-05).
Whatever carries balance extraction must still consume closing exchange rates (KB-07).
Retention of reconciliation evidence must survive in some form.
Reviewer approval must survive in some form.
